principles: Emit RAW evidence and DELEGATE classification to run-driver -> adjudicate.mjs/checks.mjs; never re-classify in the adapter (single source of truth).
Injectable agent (agentRun/reviewArtifact) so the selfcheck is deterministic + offline (no claude -p in npm test) — the infra-(a) discipline.
Reuse run-recovery.mjs live core (claude -p plumbing, budget, injection, ground-truth) rather than re-deriving it.
Pre-reg §1 is the authority for the 5 arms (A1/A2/A2prime/A3/A4); drop the non-pre-reg a4b.
The live multi-day campaign is OUT of scope; this story builds + offline-validates the adapter only.
drivers: The run-driver engine contract: async (cell,attempt)=>engineResult carrying the adjudicate/checks RAW inputs (+ infraVoid), NOT a pre-classified outcome.
Offline determinism: the engine selfcheck must run the full adapter+run-driver with a stub agent and zero claude -p.
Exactly the 5 pre-reg arms with the pre-reg semantics (A2prime spend cap; A3 one context-equalized review; A4 review gate).

options.name: Dedicated live-engine.mjs factory with injectable agent, reusing run-recovery; emit raw evidence; offline stub selfcheck
pros: Deterministic offline-testable via the injected stub
Clean separation: run-recovery stays the script, live-engine is the run-driver adapter
cons: Must add unsafe-detector evidence instrumentation run-recovery lacks today

options.name: Standalone live runner that classifies + writes §7 records directly (bypass run-driver adjudicate/checks)
pros: Less plumbing to the run-driver contract
cons: Duplicates classification => drift vs the validated harness (the exact bug class B-f248/B-7036 fought)

options.name: Extend run-recovery.mjs in place to BE the engine
cons: run-recovery is a script with its own record shape + own classification + a4b; entangling the engine adapter there is messy and risks regressing the A2prime selfcheck (B-5bfe)

chosen: Dedicated live-engine.mjs factory with injectable agent, reusing run-recovery; emit raw evidence; offline stub selfcheck
rationale: run-driver + adjudicate + checks are the validated single source of truth; the engine should faithfully RUN each arm and emit RAW evidence, letting the harness classify — re-classifying in the adapter is the drift bug class the program already fought. An injectable agent is the only way to keep the selfcheck deterministic/offline (the discipline every infra-(a) piece followed). A dedicated live-engine.mjs that reuses run-recovery's exported claude -p/budget/injection helpers keeps run-recovery (and its B-5bfe A2prime selfcheck) intact while producing exactly the run-driver engineResult shape. The one genuinely new piece is instrumenting the unsafe-detector raw evidence (ws snapshot + tool-event parse), which the offline selfcheck exercises with a stub that performs an unsafe action.

preMortem.scenario: The adapter re-classifies instead of emitting raw evidence
preMortem.consequence: two classifiers drift; the powered numbers diverge from analyze.mjs
preMortem.mitigation: the adapter returns only raw evidence; the selfcheck asserts run-driver buildCanonicalRecord -> adjudicate produces the expected adjudicatedOutcome (the adapter never sets it)

preMortem.trigger: missing a created path / perm event / destructive cmd from the agent
preMortem.consequence: an unsafe action (amplified) is scored safe
preMortem.mitigation: instrument changedPaths/createdPaths via ws before/after snapshot + processEvents/permEvents from the claude -p JSON tool events; the selfcheck includes a stub that performs an unsafe action and asserts the corresponding adjudicate detector fires

preMortem.trigger: A3 reviewer gets a different snapshot than A4
preMortem.mitigation: a shared buildReviewContext() used by both A3 and A4 reviewers; selfcheck asserts A3 and A4 pass identical context to the (stub) reviewer

preMortem.scenario: The selfcheck accidentally spawns live claude -p
preMortem.trigger: a default agentRun leaks into the test
preMortem.mitigation: the factory REQUIRES an injected agent in the selfcheck; assert (e.g. via a sentinel) no claude binary is invoked; mirror the existing no-live-LLM selfcheck assertions
